jobs.title: Job opportunities
jobs.subtitle: Open community jobs

community-stats.title: Community statistics
community-stats.subtitle: Confirmed figures only, protecting small groups
community-stats.emptyDescription: Statistics appear once donations, disbursements or profiles exist. We never show unconfirmed figures.
community-stats.thresholdNote: Any count below {{threshold}} is withheld together with its amount, to protect small groups. This threshold is provisional and awaits owner approval.
community-stats.realHidden: No real figures are shown here; separating real from demo data is mandatory, and demo figures are never presented as real achievements.

initiatives.title: Current initiatives
initiatives.subtitle: Programs open for applications
initiatives.emptyDescription: Open programs appear here. Eligibility details and amounts ship in P08 after thresholds are approved.

success-stories.title: Success stories
success-stories.subtitle: Only with an active consent from their owners
success-stories.emptyDescription: We never publish a story without a documented, active consent. Consent fields do not exist in the current contracts; publishing ships in P15.
success-stories.consentRecorded: Your consent to publish your story is recorded. You can withdraw it anytime in Settings › Privacy.

dev.description: Fills the demo repositories through the same contracts, then publishes weddings, jobs, souk items and programs, verifies partners and links offers. No auto-population.
